Good to Know

How Gold Rates Work

International Market

Local rates track global gold spot prices in US dollars.

USD/PKR Rate

The rupee exchange rate directly affects the local per-tola price.

Local Adjustments

Association-set rates and duties fine-tune the daily Sargodha price.

Daily Update

We revise our board rates daily so you always see a fair, current price.

Rate Questions

Gold Rate FAQs

Why do gold rates change during the day?

Gold is priced off the international spot market and the PKR exchange rate, both of which can move during trading hours so local shop rates are adjusted accordingly.

Do you buy back old gold at today’s rate?

For buy-back, exchange or valuation questions, please call or WhatsApp 0323 6069069 directly so we can guide you accurately.

Is the rate shown here final?

These figures are indicative reference rates. Please confirm the exact live rate by phone or WhatsApp before finalizing any purchase.

How can I check gold purityand is there a purity certificate?

Every SM Gold piece comes with a purity guarantee and certification ask us in-store to see the purity certificate for your exact karat before you buy.
